action.objective: Complete broad-search coverage of all legal moves at depth 4 to identify best candidates after Black's Kxf7.
action.rationale: Previous plan assumed Nxf7 wins a pawn, but Black actually replied Kxf7, winning the knight for a pawn. Now we must reassess the position with accurate material (we are down a knight for a pawn). Broad search over all 25 legal moves is required first before any candidate selection.
